:::{#def-test-set}
#### Test set

A **test set** is a [held-out set](#def-held-out-set)
$\paren{(x^{\text{test}}_1, y^{\text{test}}_1), \ldots, (x^{\text{test}}_{m'}, y^{\text{test}}_{m'})}$,
disjoint from the [validation set](#def-validation-set),
on which the rule of the chosen procedure $g_{\est{l}}$ is scored once,
after the choice is made:

$$
\frac{1}{m'} \sum_{j=1}^{m'}
\sqf{g_{\est{l}}\paren{x^{\text{test}}_j; \trainset} - y^{\text{test}}_j}.
$$ {#eq-test-set}

:::
